positive_snippets:
This hotel was very peaceful and welcoming. If you prefer quiet luxury, this is the place. Everything well-designed and quiet atmosphere.
Praises for friendly staff, cleanliness, comfortable beds, great locations.
The services provided by the staffs are truly awesome. Located near to the Laxminagar Nagar metro station. The staffs are really helpful and available to serve you whatever you need at any moment 💖
negative_snippets: I am very dissatisfied with my experience. Although the staff was polite and tried to be helpful, the overall cleanliness was extremely poor. The room was not properly cleaned, and the washroom was unhygienic and uncomfortable to use. Basic maintenance and hygiene standards were not met, which made the stay unpleasant. Cleanliness is a fundamental requirement, and unfortunately, it was completely lacking. Overall, it was a disappointing experience, and significant improvements are required to meet customer expectations.
